<!-- FUNCTIONS -->


```{r}
H_entropy <- function(relAbun){
  # 1. Normalize relativeAbun just in case
  p = relAbun/sum(relAbun, na.rm = TRUE)
  neg_log_p <- -log(p)
  neg_log_p[is.infinite(neg_log_p)] <- 0
  neg_log_p[is.na(neg_log_p)] <- 0
  H = sum( p*neg_log_p )
  return(H)
}
```


```{r}
ceor_stats <- function(x, na.rm=FALSE) {
  r <- c(quantile(x, probs=0.05, na.rm = na.rm),
         quantile(x, probs=0.25, na.rm = na.rm),
         quantile(x, probs=0.5, na.rm = na.rm),
         quantile(x, probs=0.75, na.rm = na.rm),
         quantile(x, probs=0.95, na.rm = na.rm),
         mean(x, na.rm=na.rm),
         sd(x, na.rm=na.rm),
         min(x, na.rm=na.rm),
         max(x, na.rm=na.rm),
         length(na.omit(x))
  )
  names(r) <- c("q05", "q25", "q50", "q75", "q95", "mean", "sd", "min", "max", "num") # Standard column names for geom_boxplot
  return(r)
}

```

```{r}
DF_SPECIES_ABUNDANCES <- read.csv("All_samples.csv") %>% 
  dplyr::select(classification, species, abundance, Metagenomes) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(abundance=as.numeric(str_replace(abundance, ",", "."))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(domain  = str_split_i(classification, ";", 1) ) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(phylum  = str_split_i(classification, ";", 2) ) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(class   = str_split_i(classification, ";", 3) ) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(order   = str_split_i(classification, ";", 4) ) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(family  = str_split_i(classification, ";", 5) ) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(genus   = str_split_i(classification, ";", 6) ) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(species = str_split_i(classification, ";", 7) ) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-classification) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(sampleID=str_replace_all(Metagenomes, "_mg", "")) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(sampleID = str_replace_all(sampleID, "D", "")) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(sampleID = str_replace_all(sampleID, "_R", "R")) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(sampleID = str_replace_all(sampleID, "_R", "R")) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(sampleID = str_replace_all(sampleID, "R", ".R")) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-Metagenomes) %>% 
  left_join(
    DF_SAMPLE_SUBJS,
    by="sampleID"
  ) %>% 
  left_join(
    DF_SAMPLEID_DAY,
    by=c("sampleID", "SUBJID")
  )  %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    species=str_replace_all(species, "__", "_"),
    genus=str_replace_all(genus, "__", "_"),
    family=str_replace_all(family, "__", "_"),
    order=str_replace_all(order, "__", "_"),
    class=str_replace_all(class, "__", "_"),
    phylum=str_replace_all(phylum, "__", "_"),
    domain=str_replace_all(domain, "__", "_")
    ) %>% 
  group_by(SUBJID) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(sum_abundance=sum(abundance)) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(RelAbun_SHTGN = abundance/sum_abundance) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(DAV = nv_ACTARMCD_DAV[ACTARMCD] )


DF_SPECIES_ABUNDANCES %>% colnames() %>% sort()
```

## Ranking Bacteria {.tabset}

One way to order the relevance of the species is to ranked to asing a meaningful id. This id could be based on the relative abundance in normal circunstances, that means that  

Considering only data from the control group and day 1 for all groups. We calculate the mean relative abundance on subjects for each species found in data

```{r}
v_TAXONMIC_RANK
```


```{r}
# dplyr::filter(species == "s__Alistipes putredinis")

DF_SPECIES_ABUNDANCES_Cts_DAY_1_only <- DF_SPECIES_ABUNDANCES %>% 
  dplyr::filter(DRUG_COMPLEX == "Ct"| DAY == 1) %>%
  # dplyr::filter(DRUG_COMPLEX == "Ct") %>%
  # group_by(SUBJID, DAY) %>% 
  group_by(sampleID) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(sum_abundance=sum(abundance)) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(RelAbun_SHTGN_Cts=abundance/sum_abundance) %>% 
  ungroup()
  

# DF_SPECIES_ABUNDANCES_Cts_DAY_1_only %>% head()

DF_BACTERIA_REF_SHTGN_Cts <- DF_SPECIES_ABUNDANCES_Cts_DAY_1_only %>% 
  # dplyr::filter(DRUG_COMPLEX == "Ct") %>% 
  group_by(domain, phylum, class, order, family, genus, species) %>% 
  dplyr::select(RelAbun_SHTGN_Cts) %>% 
  nest() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Stats = map_df(data, ~ceor_stats(.$RelAbun_SHTGN_Cts, na.rm = TRUE) )
  ) %>%
  unnest(Stats) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  dplyr::select(-data) %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(desc(num)) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(rank_numSamples_SHTGN_species = seq(1, length(num))) %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(desc(mean)) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(rank_RelAbun_SHTGN_species = seq(1, length(mean)))


```

## Diversity Indices

### Richness Index
\begin{align}
 R_{\text{day x}} &= \text{Number of OTUs in sample}
\end{align}
where x is day 1, 6 and 37

### Shannon Index
The Shannon index of a fecal sample is defined as
\begin{align}
  H_i &= - \sum_{j}^{R_i} r_{i,j} \ln r_{i,j}
\end{align}

where $i$ is the identifier of a subject, $R_i$ the Richness of the sample and
$r_{i,j}$ the relative abundance of OTU $j$ in the sample of subject $i$

## By Species

```{r}
DF_SHANNON_SHTGN_species <- DF_SPECIES_ABUNDANCES %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(DRUG_COMPLEX = factor(DRUG_COMPLEX, levels = v_DRUG_COMPLEX_levels)) %>% 
  group_by(DRUG_COMPLEX, ACTARMCD, DAV, SUBJID, DAY) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(
    Richness = sum( ifelse(!is.na(abundance>0), 1, 0) ),
    Shannon = H_entropy(RelAbun_SHTGN)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()

DF_SHANNON_SHTGN_species_stats <- DF_SHANNON_SHTGN_species %>% 
  group_by(DRUG_COMPLEX, ACTARMCD, DAV, DAY) %>%
  nest() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Stats = map_df(data, ~ceor_stats(.$Shannon, na.rm = TRUE) )
  ) %>%
  unnest(Stats) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  dplyr::select(-data)

DF_RICHNESS_SHTGN_species_stats <- DF_SHANNON_SHTGN_species %>% 
  group_by(DRUG_COMPLEX, ACTARMCD, DAV, DAY) %>%
  nest() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Stats = map_df(data, ~ceor_stats(.$Richness, na.rm = TRUE) )
  ) %>%
  unnest(Stats) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  dplyr::select(-data)


```


### Richness Shotgun

#### Difference from baseline {.tabset}

```{r}
DF_SHANNON_SHTGN_species_BASELINE <- DF_SHANNON_SHTGN_species %>% 
  dplyr::filter(DAY == 1) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Richness_Baseline = Richness) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Shannon_Baseline = Shannon) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-DAY, -Richness, -Shannon)

DF_INDEXES_SHTGN_species <- DF_SHANNON_SHTGN_species %>% 
  left_join(
    DF_SHANNON_SHTGN_species_BASELINE,
    by=c("DRUG_COMPLEX", "ACTARMCD", "DAV", "SUBJID")
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    delta_Richness = Richness - Richness_Baseline,
    delta_Shannon  = Shannon - Shannon_Baseline,
    delta_log_Shannon  = log(Shannon) - log(Shannon_Baseline)
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    DAY = factor(DAY, levels = v_DAY_levels),
    DAV = factor(DAV, levels = v_DAV_levels)
  )
```

##### Change Richness from Baseline plot NO DAV

The change of Richness from baseline defined as
\begin{align}
 \Delta R_x &= R_{\text{day x}} - R_{\text{day 1}}
\end{align}
where x is day 6 and 37



```{r}

  dplyr::filter(DAV == "NODAV")

  facet_wrap(~DRUG_COMPLEX) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = nv_DAY_color) +
  theme_bla
```

### Comments about Shannon index

Why there is a zero or almost zero shannon index, a shannon index zero means that there is no surprise no diversity the majority of species is concentrated in very few species (~1).
So lets take an example of one subject with a small shannon index with a shannon index $< 0.01$


```{r}
DF_SHANNON_SHTGN_species %>% 
  dplyr::filter(Shannon <0.01) %>% 
  flextable::flextable()


```

## Indices comparsions Wilcox test


```{r}
col_compare_1 <- "Shannon_DAY.1"
col_compare_2 <- "Shannon_DAY.6"
# res <- wilcox.test(data.str_col[[ col_compare_1 ]], data.str_col[[ col_compare_2 ]], correct=FALSE)

df_Shannon.p_value.d1_d6 <- DF_SHANNON_SHTGN_species %>% 
  dplyr::select(-Richness) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = DAY, values_from = Shannon, names_prefix = "Shannon_DAY.") %>% 
  group_by(DRUG_COMPLEX, ACTARMCD, DAV) %>% 
  summarise(
    p_value = wilcox.test(get(col_compare_1), get(col_compare_2), correct=FALSE)$p.value
    ) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Index="Shannon") %>%
```

#### Shannon Index Comparisons between Beta-lactam groups
Shannon index for different groups

```{r, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 8}
library(ggsignif)
nv_days_y_position_tmp <- c("1_6"=4, "6_37"=5, "37_1"=6)
df_Shannon_tmp <- df_Shannon.p_value %>% 
  dplyr::filter(p_value<=0.05) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(p_value = sprintf("%g", signif(p_value, digits = 4))) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(dayA=as.factor( as.integer(str_split_i(days, "_", 1) ) ) ) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(dayB=as.factor( as.integer(str_split_i(days, "_", 2) ) ) ) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(y_position=nv_days_y_position_tmp[days]) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(DAV == "NODAV")

DF_SHANNON_SHTGN_species %>% 
  dplyr::filter(DAV == "NODAV") %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(DAY=as.factor(DAY)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=DAY, y=Shannon, group=DAY)) +
  geom_violin() +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_signif(
    data = df_Shannon_tmp,
    aes(
      annotations=p_value,
      y_position=y_position,
      xmin=dayA,
      xmax=dayB
    ),
    tip_length = 0.05,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    manual = TRUE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~DRUG_COMPLEX) +
  theme_bla
  # group_by(DRUG_COMPLEX, DAV)
```

```{r}
  dplyr::summarise(

  dplyr::mutate(

  unnest(Stats) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  dplyr::select(-data)
```

### Richness Shotgun
#### Difference from baseline {.tabset}

```{r}
DF_SHANNON_SHTGN_family_BASELINE <- DF_SHANNON_SHTGN_family %>% 
  dplyr::filter(DAY == 1) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Richness_Baseline = Richness) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Shannon_Baseline = Shannon) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-DAY, -Richness, -Shannon)


DF_INDEXES_SHTGN_family <- DF_SHANNON_SHTGN_family %>% 
  left_join(
    DF_SHANNON_SHTGN_family_BASELINE,
    by=c("DRUG_COMPLEX", "ACTARMCD", "DAV", "SUBJID")
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    delta_Richness = Richness - Richness_Baseline,
    delta_log_Shannon  = log(Shannon) - log(Shannon_Baseline)
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    DAY = factor(DAY, levels = v_DAY_levels),
    DAV = factor(DAV, levels = v_DAV_levels)
  )
```




```{r}
DF_INDEXES_SHTGN_family_delta_Richness_DAY.6_p_value <- DF_INDEXES_SHTGN_family %>% 
  dplyr::select(DRUG_COMPLEX, ACTARMCD, DAV, SUBJID, DAY, delta_Richness) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = DAY, values_from = delta_Richness, names_prefix = "Richness_DAY.") %>% 
  group_by(DRUG_COMPLEX, ACTARMCD, DAV) %>% 
  nest() %>% 
  mutate(wc_p.value = map_dbl(data, ~wilcox.test(Richness_DAY.6 ~ 1, .)$p.value, correct=FALSE) ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-data) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(sig=ifelse(wc_p.value<0.05, "*", "")) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(DAY = 6)
```

```{r}
DF_FAMILY_DATA_16S <- read.csv("DF_FAMILY_DATA_16S.CSV") %>% 
  dplyr::rename("DAV"="str_DAV_DOSE") %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(DRUG_COMPLEX=factor(DRUG_COMPLEX, levels = v_DRUG_COMPLEX_levels)) %>% 
  dplyr::rename("RelAbun_16S"="RelAbun")

# DF_FAMILY_DATA_16S
```



```{r}
# DF_FAMILY_ABUNDANCES
```


```{r}
DF_SHANNON_16S_family <- DF_FAMILY_DATA_16S %>% 
  group_by(DRUG_COMPLEX, ACTARMCD, DAV, SUBJID, DAY) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(
    Richness = sum( ifelse(!is.na(Counts_16S>0), 1, 0) ),
    Shannon = H_entropy(RelAbun_16S)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()




DF_SHANNON_16S_family_stats <- DF_SHANNON_16S_family %>% 
  group_by(DRUG_COMPLEX, ACTARMCD, DAV, DAY) %>%
  nest() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Stats = map_df(data, ~ceor_stats(.$Shannon, na.rm = TRUE) )
  ) %>%
  unnest(Stats) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  dplyr::select(-data)

DF_RICHNESS_16S_family_stats <- DF_SHANNON_16S_family %>% 
  group_by(DRUG_COMPLEX, ACTARMCD, DAV, DAY) %>%
  nest() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Stats = map_df(data, ~ceor_stats(.$Richness, na.rm = TRUE) )
  ) %>%
  unnest(Stats) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  dplyr::select(-data)


```


```{r}
lbl_x <- "time (days)"
lbl_y <- "Mean Shannon Index Family 16S"
DF_SHANNON_16S_family_stats %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=DAY, y=mean)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  facet_grid(DRUG_COMPLEX~DAV) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = DF_SHANNON_16S_family_stats %>% pull(DAY) %>% unique()) +
  labs(x=lbl_x, y=lbl_y) +
  theme_bla
  
```







### Shannon Time Change plot

```{r}
str_TAXA_RANK_TMP <- "family"
str_DAV_TMP <- "NODAV"
lbl_subtitle <- sprintf("Taxonomic rank: %s, %s", str_TAXA_RANK_TMP, str_DAV_TMP)
lbl_y <- "Shannon Index"
lbl_x <- "time (days)"
DF_SHANNON_SHTGN_family %>% 
  dplyr::filter(DAV == "NODAV") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=DAY, y=Shannon)) +
  geom_point(aes(group=SUBJID), alpha=0.25) +
  geom_line (aes(group=SUBJID), alpha=0.25) +
  # geom_line (aes(y=log(Richness)), color ="red")  +
  geom_line(
    data=DF_SHANNON_SHTGN_family_stats %>% dplyr::filter(DAV == str_DAV_TMP), 
    aes(ymin=q05, lower=q25, middle=q50, upper=q75, ymax=q95, y=q50), 
    color="red",
    size = 1.25
    ) +
  facet_wrap(~DRUG_COMPLEX) +
  labs(
    x=lbl_x, y=lbl_y, subtitle = lbl_subtitle
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = DF_SHANNON_SHTGN_family %>% pull(DAY) %>% unique()) +
  theme_bla
```


### Shannon Table

```{r}
DF_SHANNON_SHTGN_family_stats %>% 
  # dplyr::mutate(across(c("q05", "q25", "q50", "q75", "q95", "mean", "sd", "min", "max")), function (x) signif(x, digits = 3)) %>% 
  flextable::flextable() %>% 
  flextable::theme_zebra() %>% 
  flextable::merge_v( j=c("DRUG_COMPLEX", "ACTARMCD", "DAV")) %>% 
  flextable::colformat_double(
    big.mark = ",", digits = 2, na_str = "N/A"
  )

```



# Original data 16S withou Family agglomeration


```{r}
DF_SUBJS_TMP <- DF_FAMILY_DATA_16S %>% 
  dplyr::select(DRUG_COMPLEX, DAV, ACTARMCD, SUBJID) %>% distinct()
```


```{r}
adpf <- readRDS("data_original/adpf.RDS") %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(DAY = as.integer( str_replace(AVISIT, "DAY ", "") ) ) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(SUBJID=as.integer(SUBJID)) %>% 
  left_join(
    DF_SUBJS_TMP,
    by=c("ACTARMCD", "SUBJID")
  )

v_DAY_levels <- adpf %>% pull(DAY) %>%  unique() %>% sort()

df_OBSOTUS_original <- adpf %>% dplyr::filter(PARAMCD == "OBSOTUS") %>% dplyr::mutate(DAY=factor(DAY, levels = v_DAY_levels))

df_SHANNON_original <- adpf %>% dplyr::filter(PARAMCD == "SHANNON") %>% dplyr::mutate(DAY=factor(DAY, levels = v_DAY_levels))

df_OBSOTUS_original_stats <- df_OBSOTUS_original %>% 
  group_by(DRUG_COMPLEX, ACTARMCD, DAV, DAY) %>%
  nest() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Stats = map_df(data, ~ceor_stats(.$AVAL, na.rm = TRUE) )
  ) %>%
  unnest(Stats) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  dplyr::select(-data) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(param="Richness")
  


df_SHANNON_original_stats <- df_SHANNON_original %>% 
  group_by(DRUG_COMPLEX, ACTARMCD, DAV, DAY) %>%
  nest() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Stats = map_df(data, ~ceor_stats(.$AVAL, na.rm = TRUE) )
  ) %>%
  unnest(Stats) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  dplyr::select(-data) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(param ="Shannon")

```




```{r}
# DF_INDEXES_SHTGN_family_Summary_TMP
lbl_x <- "time (days)"

df_OBSOTUS_original_stats %>%

  theme_bla

```
